description: This source file defines the LiteralAILogger class, a specialized logger for integrating with the LiteralAI observability platform. It includes methods for logging success and failure events, batching logs, and constructing GraphQL queries for ingestion.

classes.name: LiteralAILogger
classes.description: A logger class that sends logging data to the LiteralAI platform, supporting both synchronous and asynchronous operations.

methods.name: _send_batch(self)

methods.description: Asynchronously logs a success event, with batch sending if needed.
